usage: Replace the custom-poster hero artwork with the exact YOUR / DESIGN / HERE placeholder on desktop and mobile. The collection cover uses matching native text on its center print.

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is ONLY the typography and product-placeholder reference, not a scene reference. Change ONLY the artwork inside the large portrait paper poster in Image 1. Remove the entire mountain-and-lake photograph inside that print, replacing it with clean white matte paper and bold black condensed sans-serif lettering in the same strong typographic style as the product mockup in Image 2. The exact text must be three centered stacked lines: 'YOUR' / 'DESIGN' / 'HERE'. Do NOT include the word UPLOAD or any other words. Generous clean white margins, perfectly readable, large professional black typography. Match the print's existing perspective, natural paper surface, warm lighting and shadows. Preserve the whole original scene: the poster's exact position and size, its white paper edge, charcoal wall, walnut desk, orange lamp, camera, sketchbook, all props, original crop, and all empty dark areas reserved for HTML copy. Do not alter the room, add new objects, add text anywhere outside the poster, add logos or a watermark. Keep the original landscape wide hero composition and its empty dark LEFT half.
